name: Cooperative Search and Rescue
summary: Sweep a search area cooperatively, localise a distress beacon, mark it and guide a ground element.
objective: Sweep {search_area} with {uav_count} UAVs at {detection_alt_m} m using a {sweep_width_m} m sweep width until the distress beacon is detected, localised to within {localize_err_m} m and marked.
brief: A distress beacon is active somewhere in {search_area}. Sweep the area cooperatively at {detection_alt_m} m with {sweep_width_m} m spacing between tracks so that at least 95% of the area is observed once. When a UAV detects the signal, localise it to within {localize_err_m} m, mark the spot (hover >= 10 s and transmit the position) and hand the position to the rescue element. Do not leave uncovered strips when the first detection happens.

parameters.name: beacon_cell
parameters.desc: Cell holding the beacon (unknown to the agent)

preconditions: beacon frequency known to the payload

actions: report the beacon to the team

checkpoints.name: Sweep coverage
checkpoints.metric: area observed at least once before task end

checkpoints.name: Detection
checkpoints.target: detected before the task window closes

checkpoints.name: Localisation
checkpoints.metric: error of the transmitted beacon position

checkpoints.name: Marking and handover
checkpoints.metric: hover time at the beacon and handover message
checkpoints.target: hover >= 10 s and handover message sent

checkpoints.name: No uncovered strip
checkpoints.metric: uncovered strips left when detection happens

failure_conditions: beacon not detected within the window
abandoning the sweep to chase a false signal
constraints: no flight inside the marked danger radius before the rescue element arrives
grading: global checkpoint pass rate; checkpoint weights sum to 100
